audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Rune Prison as a flat root — the focus field, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, loading and report[9].t all call it "Rune Prison (Root)" and tell the reader to count its cooldown. It is conditional.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted." So the ability that actually decides whether you get locked down is Spell Flux (E), up every 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5 seconds. Stay clear of Flux and the cage is a slow.
audit.corrected: The Flux condition is now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, report[3].t, dontsFull[2], loading, report[9].t and content spikes[0].text and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave levels 4-5 and 6 to "Skill" and both item stages to Ryze, while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both give all seven stages to Neeko against a 66.67% owner win rate over 114 games.
audit.why: Neeko's root reaches 1000 and Rune Prison reaches 615; Ryze has no dash, so Pop Blossom at 6 is a commit he cannot leave; and the content layer's reasoning — that Neeko's burst item lands before his stacking combo scales — matches a kit whose damage comes from accumulated bonus mana.
audit.corrected: The four disagreeing rows moved to Neeko with their whys and ratings rewritten in the same proposal; diffRating and carryRating brought down to match a lane the data says Neeko wins two games in three.

audit.corrected: Fabrication removed; the phase whys now run on his lack of mobility, on Rune Prison's 615 range against your 1000, and on Realm Warp at 180/160/140 being a repositioning tool rather than a fight ultimate.

notes: BEST FIND: the page called the ability "Rune Prison (Root)" and built the whole green-light system on its cooldown, but Riot's text says it damages and SLOWS, and only roots "if the target has Flux on it". The ability the reader actually has to respect is Spell Flux (E) on 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5 — walk clear of the debuff and the cage is a slow. That condition is now stated in eleven places across both layers. Note the focus.text field still reads "Ryze Rune Prison (Root)"; I left it because it follows the AbilityName (Effect) convention the brief says not to "fix", but it is the one place the conditional reading is not visible — flagged in questionsForUser. CHART: full-layer rows 4-5, 6, first item and two-plus items said Skill/Skill/Ryze/Ryze while content win[] and packet.levelChart both said Neeko on all seven, against a 66.67% win rate over 114 games. I moved the four disagreeing rows to Neeko with matched whys and ratings, and lowered diffRating and carryRating plus the two difficulty strings to stop the page calling a two-in-three lane a coin flip. I left the diff token as "EVEN" rather than guess at a more favourable one. FABRICATION REMOVED: phases[4].why's "3-second knockup". NO DASH: nothing in Ryze's kit carries the dash flag, which is what makes the level 6 Pop Blossom claim safe to state.
